name: Portfolio discovery: verify company
prompt:
Verify one possible portfolio company of {{firm}} (also written as: {{aliases}}; NOT the same as: {{collisions}}).

Company: {{__item.name}}. Domain on file: {{__item.domain}}. Found by: {{__item.lanes}}. Evidence so far: {{__item.evidence}}. Latest date hint: {{__item.latest_hint}}. Round hints: {{__item.round_hints}}.

Work efficiently. Start from the evidence links above (if the only source is salesforce, open that funding link first); search further only when they don't settle a question.

1. backing: is {{firm}} a confirmed investor in, or accelerator of, this company? "Confirmed" needs a primary or reputable source: the firm's own site or posts, the company's own announcement, or a reputable news article or database page naming the firm as investor or cohort. A name match to a different firm doesn't count. Give the best source URL.
2. domain: the company's own website domain (bare, e.g. acme.com). Blank if you can't confirm it. Note if it's stealth.
3. Latest completed funding round for the company (any investor): type (Pre-Seed, Seed, Series A, ...), announced date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM if only the month is known), amount in USD, lead investors, and a source URL. Only completed equity or venture rounds count: exclude fund closes, plans or rumors, pure debt, grants, IPOs, acquisitions and secondary sales. Joining a cohort is not a round.
4. firm_in_latest_round: did {{firm}} take part in that latest round?
5. round_in_window: is that latest round announced on or after {{since}}?
Leave any field blank (or Unknown) rather than guess.

backing.description: Is the firm a confirmed investor or accelerator of this company

is_stealth.description: True if the company is in stealth or has no public website

company_domain.description: Company's own bare domain, blank if unconfirmed

round_in_window.description: Is the latest round on or after the window start

latest_round_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM, blank if unknown

latest_round_type.description: Latest completed round type, blank if unknown

backing_source_url.description: Best source URL confirming the relationship

firm_in_latest_round.description: Did the firm take part in the latest round

latest_round_source_url.description: Source URL for the latest round
